# hivenet Provider

The Hivenet provider manages Hivenet Compute resources through the public API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hivenet = {
      source = "hivenetcode/hivenet"
    }
  }
}

# The API key can also come from HIVENET_TOKEN.
provider "hivenet" {
  token = var.hivenet_token
}

variable "hivenet_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the public API, including `/v1`. Defaults to `https://api.hivecompute.ai/v1`. Can also be set with the `HIVENET_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API key for the Hivenet Compute public API. Can also be set with the `HIVENET_TOKEN` environment variable.
